description: Configuration the agent boots with for the acoustic-resolution dial it owns: how finely it summarises the cochlear trajectory into frequency bands for discrimination, and when to raise that. resolution is the starting band count; ladder is the step sequence it climbs (3->6->12->25); max_resolution is the finest (25 = the A1 patch count); trickle is the discriminative-hypotheses-per-cycle at or below which generation counts as drying; saturate_after is how many such cycles (with poor recognition) before stepping up; poor_recognition_frac is the recognition fraction below which recognition counts as still-poor. All dials live here, not in Python.
